text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Aha, the skies have cleared up, haven't they!
Come, let us train to our hearts' content!
So, I came to a deserted island with Tucker Brine for a day camp! Today, we're catching and cooking our own lunch and dinner.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Let's secure some food right away!
We're catching a big one! DWAHAHA!
However—

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
............
Nnnnot even a single nibble, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Did the water temperature drop from yesterday's heavy rain?
The fish might have dived deeper into the water.
Now then, what to do……
(*Grummbleee……*)

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Hm! Are you all right?
My apologies, I assumed
we'd catch something right away...
choice_data_list: N-No, I should be the one apologizing...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Can't be helped.
I'd like to say this is all part of survival, but we shouldn't push it. Let's have canned emergency rations for lunch!

It felt pathetic, but I didn't want to collapse and cause trouble, so I took them up on their offer.
Even so, this camp has been plenty of fun...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Right on!
Well, taste is secondary when it comes to real survival anyway...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
However... hmm...
......

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san. After all, I think I'd like to give it another hard try.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I came all the way out to this deserted island to train.
I want to push survival to its absolute limits!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: However, this is merely my own stubborn pride. Please, just rest over there!

Curious about how she was doing,
I decided to go after her...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Oh, silverberries and mushrooms...!
There's actually quite a lot.
choice_data_list: You found some food, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but it's still not enough.
This much will hardly fill an empty stomach.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
If this were real survival, I'd end up
wasting away from a lack of protein...

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's come to this...
I'll just have to hunt down that legendary wild forage!

She tore across the entire island!
Crossing rivers, scaling cliffs, crossing suspension bridges without fear.
And then――!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Aha! There it is! Found it!
It's the 'Jack Yummy-Yummy Bean'!

Where she was pointing, there was
a beanstalk bearing a bean pod
the size of a sleeping bag...!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
These beans have crazy hard pods!
Even with an Umamusume's strength, cracking them open is quite a chore!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Heat barely penetrates it! You have to pound it, peel it, and boil it for hours! Only then does it become something fit to eat!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Ah! But this is what survival is all about!
If this is all we've got, then we have to eat it!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Now, watch closely, Trainer.
Behold the clash of absolute willpower...
between this bean and myself--!!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhh!!
(BAM! BAM! CRACK!)

She slammed the bean pods she'd harvested
against the rocky ground.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Owooh! Toriyaaaaahhh!!!
All right! It split open wide!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Now all that's left is boiling it!
Should take about two hours, give or take!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I can do this... I can endure it now!
This is the power awakened at the very limit!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~~ That was delicious!
Just the salt from the seawater was enough to...!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! That oughta shed another layer off my old self!
I must be one step closer to becoming a truly wild Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Training out in nature truly holds profound significance...!
We must unleash our wild instincts even further!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
We need to use it with far more bravado!
Following pure instinct!!

I suddenly remembered the day we bought that Dream Lottery ticket.
Was she trying to break away from her "serious" and "steady" image back then...?

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
I harvested a whole bunch of beans, so
would you like a taste too?
Go ahead and savor Mother Nature at her finest!!

It seems Tucker Brine aspires to be wild.
Watching her pursue that goal with such earnestness brought a warm smile to my face.
